name: @educateos/assessment-ai
description: EducateOS optional Assessment CI backends (roadmap E03): AI semantic feedback through a governed model port with excerpt-verified, ai-suggested evidence; an optional execution sandbox that fails closed where the district plan lacks it; teacher overrides and releases; and pure teacher and student rubric report view models. Its `./durable-object-store` entry point is the optional runs' Durable Object SQLite store. A library, not a deployable Worker.
